abstract: Sublingual dermoid cysts are uncommon in the head and neck region. They are most often seen in young adults and can become unusually large with few symptoms. A case is presented to demonstrate the slow, expansive growth pattern and relatively painless swelling in the floor of the mouth that occurred over a 9-year period.
abstract_ja: 舌下類皮嚢腫は頭頸部では稀である。若年成人に多く、大きくなるまで症状が乏しいことがある。本症例は、9年間にわたる緩徐な膨張性発育と、口腔底の比較的無痛性の腫脹を示した。
